description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMetaDataParser' used for parsing metadata in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM modules. It includes properties for field definitions, view definitions, module name, and implementation details, along with methods for retrieving layout, language, history, and field definitions, as well as static utility methods for field validation and standardization.

classes.name: AbstractMetaDataParser
classes.description: An abstract class providing metadata parsing functionalities for SuiteCRM modules, including methods for managing field definitions, layout, language, and validation.

methods.name: getLayoutAsArray
methods.description: Returns the panels layout as an array.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the language associated with the implementation.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Gets the history object from the implementation.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Attempts to remove a field by name; default returns false.

methods.name: validField
methods.description: Determines if a field definition is valid and should be shown in Studio/ModuleBuilder, based on visibility and type criteria.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Static method placeholder for trimming field definitions.

methods.name: getRequiredFields
methods.description: Returns an array of required field names.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Abstract method for handling save operations in subclasses.
